name: Let it Burn
approach: From the Stuart Lake Trailhead (FS Road 7601 off Icicle Creek Road), hike the Colchuck Lake Trail (#1599) to Colchuck Lake — forest along Mountaineer Creek, a log-bridge crossing at 1.5 miles, right at the Lake Stuart Trail junction, then a boulder-moraine finish to the outlet (about 4 miles, 2,280 ft gain). Fill water here — it's the last source. Cross the outlet and continue toward the lake's south/east side onto the cairned Aasgard Pass climbers' trail, gaining talus/heather to roughly 400 ft above the lake, then cut left through dense brush to the obvious base gully below Colchuck Balanced Rock. From the gully, scramble up a 3rd-class ramp to the actual base of the technical climbing. A documented approach for this route took about 3 hours 47 minutes trailhead-to-base, matching the 3.5-4 hour estimate.
